title: I'm in shock that I found this sub
content: I have always called this place my "dreamscape." It's centered around two malls; one is modern and almost futuristic, as described, with a massive stationary store and little Japantown, the other is run down and constantly closing and shares a parking lot with a Chinese food place and a Toys R Us. In the run-down mall, the lighting is very warm, there's a Hot Topic in the process of closing, and everything is very normal... save for the lavender storefront with the fortune-telling spider. Hear me out. This storefront is painted entirely lavender, and empty save for a 6-foot tall fuzzy brown spider. It sits like a human being at a folding table and tells fortunes, and every time I've seen it I've been too nervous to interact. My dreams are set in these two malls fairly often, and I recently gained another location in this setting, a small house that operates as a haunted house during Halloween with the top floor serving as a tattoo studio. It's in a little suburban neighborhood and very cozy. I'm actually shaking typing this because I'm in total disbelief. The settings in this sub sound like my dreamscape. Have any of you been to the run-down mall and also seen the spider?
